description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: John proclaims the word of life, which was revealed and which the apostles heard, saw and touched. God is light, and those who walk in the light have fellowship and are cleansed from sin, while those who confess their sins are forgiven.
1.sw: Yohana anatangaza neno la uzima, lililofunuliwa na ambalo mitume walilisikia, kuliona na kuligusa. Mungu ni nuru, na wale wanaoenenda katika nuru wana ushirika na wanatakaswa dhambi, na wale wanaoziungama dhambi zao wanasamehewa.
1.am: ዮሐንስ የተገለጠውንና ሐዋርያት የሰሙትን፣ ያዩትንና የዳሰሱትን የሕይወት ቃል ያውጃል። እግዚአብሔር ብርሃን ነው፤ በብርሃን የሚመላለሱ ኅብረት አላቸው፤ ከኃጢአትም ይነጻሉ፤ ኃጢአታቸውን የሚናዘዙም ይቅር ይባላሉ።

2.en: Jesus is our advocate with the Father, and whoever knows God keeps God's commands and walks as Jesus walked. Believers must not love the world, must beware of the antichrists who deny the Son, and remain in what they were taught.
2.sw: Yesu ni mtetezi wetu mbele ya Baba, na yeyote anayemjua Mungu huzishika amri za Mungu na kuenenda kama Yesu alivyoenenda. Waamini hawapaswi kuupenda ulimwengu, lazima wajihadhari na wapinga-Kristo wanaomkana Mwana, na kudumu katika yale waliyofundishwa.
2.am: ኢየሱስ በአብ ዘንድ ጠበቃችን ነው፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያውቅም ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዛት ይጠብቃል፤ ኢየሱስም እንደ ተመላለሰ ይመላለሳል። አማኞች ዓለምን ሊወዱ አይገባም፤ ወልድን ከሚክዱ ፀረ ክርስቶሶች ሊጠነቀቁና በተማሩት ሊኖሩ ይገባቸዋል።

3.en: God's great love has made believers children of God, and those who do what is right show it, while the children of the devil go on sinning. Love means laying down one's life for others, in action and truth.
3.sw: Upendo mkuu wa Mungu umewafanya waamini kuwa watoto wa Mungu, na wale wanaotenda haki wanaonyesha hivyo, huku watoto wa Ibilisi wakiendelea kutenda dhambi. Upendo maana yake ni kuutoa uhai wako kwa ajili ya wengine, kwa tendo na kwa kweli.
3.am: የእግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ፍቅር አማኞችን የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች አድርጓቸዋል፤ ጽድቅን የሚያደርጉም ይህን ያሳያሉ፤ የዲያብሎስ ልጆች ግን ኃጢአት ማድረጋቸውን ይቀጥላሉ። ፍቅር ማለት በተግባርና በእውነት ሕይወትን ስለ ሌሎች አሳልፎ መስጠት ነው።

4.en: Believers are to test the spirits, for every spirit that confesses Jesus come in the flesh is from God. God is love, shown in sending the Son, and perfect love has no room for fear.
4.sw: Waamini wanapaswa kuzijaribu roho, kwa maana kila roho inayokiri kwamba Yesu amekuja katika mwili inatoka kwa Mungu. Mungu ni upendo, kama inavyoonekana katika kumtuma Mwana, na upendo kamili hauna nafasi kwa hofu.
4.am: አማኞች መናፍስትን ሊፈትኑ ይገባቸዋል፤ ኢየሱስ በሥጋ እንደ መጣ የሚመሰክር መንፈስ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ነውና። እግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ነው፤ ይህም ወልድን በመላኩ ታይቷል፤ ፍጹም ፍቅርም ለፍርሃት ስፍራ የለውም።

5.en: Everyone born of God overcomes the world through faith that Jesus is the Son of God. John writes so that believers may know that they have eternal life, and ends with what they know.
5.sw: Kila aliyezaliwa na Mungu huushinda ulimwengu kwa imani kwamba Yesu ni Mwana wa Mungu. Yohana anaandika ili waamini wajue kwamba wana uzima wa milele, na anamalizia kwa yale wanayoyajua.
5.am: ከእግዚአብሔር የተወለደ ሁሉ ኢየሱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ በማመን ዓለምን ያሸንፋል። ዮሐንስ አማኞች የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዳላቸው እንዲያውቁ ይጽፋል፤ በሚያውቋቸው ነገሮችም ይደመድማል።
